pages.name: English: Lukin, 5.Nd2 Nf6 6.e3
pages.notes: Overview called the structure a reversed KIA against a Stonewall; plan read the f1-square as a move. Rewritten around Black's e4-pawn, f3/g4 and ...c5/...d5. Reviewer rejection (Nb3 then b4 is impossible) fixed and re-reviewed.

pages.name: English: Lukin, 5.Ng5
pages.notes: Plans had Qb3 targeting e6 through White's own c4-pawn, a bishop route f1-b5 through the e2-pawn and e5 read as a move. Rewritten around the attack on e4. Reviewer rejections (...Be7 and ...c6 do not defend e4) fixed and re-reviewed.

pages.name: English: Lukin, 5.Ng5 Be7
pages.notes: Plans had h4 and Nh3-f2 against e4 and ...g5 to attack White's king. Rewritten around Nh3-f4 or 6.h4 Bxg5 7.hxg5.

pages.name: English: Lukin, 5.Ng5 c6
pages.notes: Plans had the g5-knight going to e6 (covered by the c8-bishop) and e6 read as a move. Rewritten around f3, h3/g4 and ...Qb6 or ...Qa5.

pages.name: English: Bremen, Reverse Dragon, 4.cxd5 Nxd5
pages.notes: Plans had ...e6 with the e-pawn on e5 and a d6-pawn that does not exist. Rewritten as a reversed Dragon.

pages.name: English: Bremen, Reverse Dragon, 4.cxd5 Nxd5 5.Bg2 Nb6
pages.notes: Plans had a d4-pawn break read as a move and a minority attack against the b6-knight. Rewritten around a3/b4/Rb1 and ...f6/...a5. Reviewer rejection (...a5 does not fix the b-pawn; b5 follows) fixed and re-reviewed.

pages.name: English: Bremen, Smyslov, 4.Bg2
pages.notes: Plans had Rb1 and b4 with the bishop on b4, the queen's knight going to e2, and a knight to f4 against the g2-bishop. Rewritten around ...Re8/...e4 and the d5-square.

pages.name: English: Bremen, Smyslov, 4.Bg2 O-O 5.e4
pages.notes: Plans had Nge2 breaking a pin that does not exist and a knight route ...Ne7-g6 from f6. Rewritten around Nge2/d3/f4 and ...Bxc3 or ...c6/...d5.

pages.name: English: King's, 2.Nc3 Nf6 3.e3 Bb4
pages.notes: Overview called ...Bb4 a pin (the d2-pawn shields the king); plan had bxc3 before ...Bxc3. Rewritten around Nge2 or Qc2. Reviewer rejection (the b4-bishop does not eye e4 directly) fixed and re-reviewed.

pages.name: English: King's, 2.Nc3 Nf6 3.e4
pages.notes: Plans had an f2-f4-f5 route and the c5- and b4-squares read as moves. Rewritten around the d5- and d4-squares.

pages.name: English: Nimzo-English, 4.g3
pages.notes: Follow-up to batch 14: overview said the b4-bishop eyes the e4-square (it guards it only indirectly, through the c3-knight). Reworded and re-reviewed.
